ModMetaData.name: Celestial Lighting — Test Probes
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Dev-only, unpublished. Registers CelestialLighting's IProbe implementations with RimWorldTestHarness so Scenarios/*.json can assert against them. Never load this alongside CelestialLighting in a real playthrough's mod list — it exists purely for RimWorldTestHarness/Runner/run_test.sh runs.
